es.title: Noticias de Copyright e Inteligencia Artificial
es.subtitle: Notas publicadas por medios reales de la industria, con liga al artículo original. Sin noticias inventadas.

items.title: DistroKid’s $2 billion valuation based on it being a pipeline for AI slop and copyright infringement, says Universal
items.summary: Universal claims that distributor DistroKid achieved its recent $2 billion valuation by providing a pipeline for AI slop and copyright infringing music, to the detriment of artists and labels. It has filed a lawsuit accusing DistroKid of copyright infringement and unlawful deceptive trade practices

items.title: Suno estrena sus modelos v6 con Warner, BMG y Believe
items.summary: Suno, una de las principales plataformas de música con inteligencia artificial y objeto de demandas por derechos de autor en varios frentes, ha lanzado su suite de modelos v6, la primera que la compañía desarrolla con socios de la industria: Warner Music Group, BMG y Believe. Con este estreno, la firma retira simultáne…

items.title: Universal Music Group Sues DistroKid Over Alleged Copyright Infringement and AI-Generated Music
Landmark termination rights ruling not the “copyright emergency” music publishers claim, songwriter tells US Supreme Court
items.summary: When America’s Fifth Circuit Appeals Court backed a songwriter-friendly interpretation of the termination right in US copyright law, the majors bought the song that prompted that ruling and asked the Supreme Court to intervene. The writer of that song has now urged the top court to not get involved

items.title: UMG demanda a DistroKid por ‘slop’ de IA y violación de derechos de autor
Suno lanza un nuevo modelo de IA para música tras múltiples demandas por derechos de autor
UMG firma un acuerdo global de IA con ElevenLabs
items.summary: Universal Music Group (UMG) ha firmado un acuerdo de licencia plurianual con ElevenLabs, la compañía de inteligencia artificial de audio valorada en 11.000 millones de dólares. Es el primer pacto de ElevenLabs con una gran discográfica y contempla el lanzamiento de una nueva plataforma de música con IA para fans, ademá…

items.title: AI artists will somehow play ‘live’ at their own awards ceremony in November
items.summary: AI-generated 'artists' including Xania Monet will 'perform' live on stage at the first AI Music Awards in Los Angeles in November. Source

items.title: SubmitHub bans AI-generated music from its promotion services
items.summary: Earlier this year, music-promo platform SubmitHub revealed research suggesting that 23.2% of the tracks being submitted were fully AI-generated. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Canciones creadas con IA abren un nuevo debate sobre derechos de autor
"Tengo una visión del futuro": el director de Suno defiende su modelo de IA musical en medio de la desconfianza de la industria
Suno unveils upgrade developed with “music industry partners”, while continuing to battle the music industry in court
items.summary: Suno has unveiled v6 of its music AI platform, which has been developed with its industry partners like Warner Music, BMG and Believe. However, even as it starts to work with some labels and publishers on new AI products, it continues to fight other music companies in the courts

tip.title: Registra tu catálogo también en la sociedad de gestión
tip.body: El registro de autoría y la recaudación son trámites distintos. Si tu obra no está dada de alta en la sociedad correspondiente, las regalías de ejecución pública simplemente no te llegan.

tip.title: Register with your collecting society too
tip.body: Copyright registration and royalty collection are separate steps. If your work isn't registered with the right society, public performance royalties simply never reach you.
